metadata.short_desc: Customize QQ Official bot command panel content via AstrBot WebUI
metadata.desc: Displays user-customized command entries in the QQ Official bot command panel. Users add the commands they want to show, the plugin writes them verbatim to the panel. Supports 4 scenes: private chat, group chat, text channel, channel DM.

language.hint: zh-CN=Simplified Chinese, en-US=English. Affects logger output; user-authored selected_commands entries are NOT translated.

scenes.description: Active scenes (where QQ command panel is visible)
scenes.hint: c2c=Private chat, group=Group chat, channel=Text sub-channel, dm=Channel DM. channel/dm only support global configuration.

qq_platforms.hint: Fill in appid + clientSecret to sync command panels directly, independent of whether qq_official adapter is configured in AstrBot dashboard. Add multiple entries for multiple bots. ⚠️ secret is saved in plain text, DO NOT screenshot share.

name.hint: Used only to distinguish entries in the panel, can be left empty

appid.hint: AppID in QQ Bot Dashboard -> Development Settings -> Bot Basic Info

secret.hint: ⚠️ Saved in plain text, DO NOT screenshot share this page

platform.hint: Default qq_official works for most cases

selected_commands.description: Custom command entries to show in the QQ command panel
selected_commands.hint: Manually add entries to display in the QQ command panel. Each {name, desc} is written verbatim, independent of commands already registered in AstrBot. Max 20 entries; name ≤ 14 chars, desc ≤ 30 chars.

name.hint: The name users see in the QQ panel, e.g. /foo; leading / is optional

desc.hint: Max 30 chars, displayed in the QQ panel

dashboard.title: Command Panel
dashboard.description: Visually configure the entries written to the QQ Official bot command panel.

status.title: Overview
status.subtitle: Check the current state of each QQ platform and its on-line command panel.
status.mockHint: Local dev environment: showing mock data, not connected to the AstrBot backend.

platforms.title: No QQ platform available yet
platforms.description: Fill in appid / ClientSecret under qq_platforms in the plugin config, or enable a qq_official adapter in the AstrBot platform settings.

commands.description: No command entries configured; syncing would delete the panels created by this plugin. Add entries under selected_commands in the plugin config.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Panel entries and platform credentials are kept on the plugin config page.
settings.placeholderTitle: Configuration still lives on the plugin config page
settings.placeholder: This page is not implemented yet. Change the current options on the plugin config page of the AstrBot WebUI and reload the plugin to apply them.
